name: Shitogi Eris
source:
A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including [url=/c7198]Shizuku[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sono_Hanabira_ni_Kuchizuke_o]Wikipedia[/url]]
